messages:
maya: Heads-up — we want to migrate a bunch of services in staging from projected serviceAccount tokens -> Vault Agent + ExternalSecrets this week. I'll open the terraform + helm diffs shortly. Need a quick safety review for rotation/race conditions.

alex: high level rollout? all at once or per-namespace canary?

maya: per-namespace canary. plan:
- add ExternalSecret CRs for apps that currently mount k8s secrets created from projected tokens
- run vault-agent sidecar template to write the k8s secret (or use CSI driver later)
- Terraform will create ExternalSecret resources via our k8s module and keep projected tokens for a 24h grace window
- vault role TTLs set to 6h so rotation exercises frequent refresh

chris: couple concerns — when ExternalSecret replaces a secret we can get pod restarts. need rolling update strategy and a readiness probe tolerant to short/empty file state.

sam: also watch kubelet race: if secret gets deleted then recreated, mounts can briefly be empty. We used initContainers in past to wait for secret file. Suggest this pattern:

```yaml
initContainers:
  - name: wait-for-secret
    image: busybox
    command: ['sh','-c','until [ -f /etc/creds/token ]; do sleep 1; done']
    volumeMounts:
      - name: creds
        mountPath: /etc/creds
```

maya: good point. Another mitigation: create new secret name (app1-creds-v2) and update deployment to point to v2, then delete old after stable. avoids delete/recreate flip.

alex: Terraform change? small snippet so reviewers know scope?

maya: will push shortly but example pattern:

```hcl
resource "kubernetes_manifest" "app1_external_secret" {
  manifest = yamldecode(file("./manifests/app1-externalsecret.yaml"))
}
```

and the ExternalSecret YAML will look like:

```yaml
apiVersion: external-secrets.io/v1beta1
kind: ExternalSecret
metadata:
  name: app1-creds-v2
  namespace: payments
spec:
  refreshInterval: 1h
  secretStoreRef:
    name: vault-prod
    kind: ClusterSecretStore
  target:
    name: app1-creds-v2
    template:
      type: Opaque
  data:
    - secretKey: token
      remoteRef:
        key: apps/payments/app1/token
```

chris: minor nit: refreshInterval 1h + vault TTL 6h means secret may outlive token if agent not refreshed; ensure agent template handles renewing or use shorter refreshInterval.

maya: agreed, I'll set refreshInterval=30m for canary. Also we should add an annotation to suppress external-secrets from reconciling during deployment roll (operator pause). Something like: `external-secrets.io/paused: "true"` before deploy, remove after.

sam: team should be aware of RBAC change: Vault auth role -> k8s serviceaccount mapping. Terraform will add role binding; please add approvers in PR.

deploy-bot: staged cluster capacity check: staging has 12 nodes, canary batch size 10% across namespaces (label selector = canary=true). Start window 09:00 PST tomorrow.

oncall: will the rollout cause any SLO blips? if so we need a runbook. Post expected error signatures (401 from downstream if token not present) and monitoring query.

maya: good call. I'll add a short runbook to the PR: symptoms (502/401), rollback (flip back to old secret env var and re-deploy), and paging threshold (>=5% errors for 5m).

alex: who watches the first canary? @chris?

chris: I'll take first watch and stay on slack for the window.

maya: thanks — PR coming in ~30m. tagging reviewers: @alex @sam @chris. :thumbsup:
